card.line: Cenchreae was the eastern harbor of Corinth, a port city where Paul kept a vow and where a church was served by Phoebe.

moments.title: Paul keeps his vow
moments.text: After staying in Corinth for quite some time, Paul said goodbye to the brothers. He had his head shaved in Cenchrea to keep a vow he had made, and then he sailed for Syria with Priscilla and Aquila.

moments.title: Phoebe, servant of the church
moments.text: Phoebe was a servant of the church in Cenchrea. Paul spoke well of her and said she had been a great help to many people, including him.
